pr_title: Bound FTS5 tombstone hash growth before scaling record counts
pr_description: Keep the tombstone element count unsigned and compare it with one quarter of the page capacity before calculating the slot count. Counts that exceed this limit use the existing multi-page rebuild path, keeping hash growth bounded even for corrupted records.

Add tests and fixes for the new code on this branch.

FossilOrigin-Name: 5aac50e92e956b15367c75c20c17bc1c75e84e2752bfffe4ad0a266cb9bd3b8a
fix_commit_message:
Fix a signed-integer overflow in fts5 that might occur when dealing with strategicly corrupted records. Bug [bugs:/info/2026-06-10T03:56:42Z | 2026-06-10T03:56:42Z].

FossilOrigin-Name: fc6442ee54795fbeb746539193716238aa653d80170523bc327ae3ce0d945ebf
agent_reasoning: Casting the unsigned record count to int and multiplying it by four could cause signed integer overflow and bypass the page-size check. The source now retains the u32 value and checks the capacity limit before multiplication, matching the supplied security change. Only ext/fts5/fts5_index.c was edited; existing feature and test changes remain intact. git diff --check and validate_pr_state passed.
